instruction: Browse Spider-Man toys for kids and sort by best sellers.

metadata.explanation: Same product category as original but different sort order (Best Sellers instead of Price Low-High).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: product category navigation (Spider-Man, Toys, Kids) and sort order (Best Sellers)

Metric logic (check_direct_json_object) performs correct comparison of extracted values against expected values
Expected values are semantically correct: checks for 'spider-man', 'toys', 'kids', and 'best sellers' as lowercase boolean flags
